short: Eligible orbits at a candidate inert prime

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.VV
lean.plain: Eligible orbits at a candidate inert prime
lean.note: An orbit can use the $g_U$ estimate after its penalty only if it belongs to $VV$. To include the regular orbits, the construction requires a candidate inert prime, orbit length at least $x^{\epsilon/4}$, and a smallness bound summed over the regular orbits.
